summary: Sacred Site and elephant civ. Delhi plays the same mosque opener every game, raids with Ghazi Raiders, takes Sacred Sites around 6:30 and wins Castle with elephants and archers.
openings: Mosque from the 6th villager, Feudal around 2:30, Dome of the Faith almost every game so scholars cost 80 gold.
Fast Ghazi Raiders: stable with 5 on wood and the first Ghazi around 4:45.

spikes.label: Sacred Sites
spikes.detail: Scholars take Sacred Sites one at a time from around 6:30. All three are worth roughly 375 gold a minute.
spikes.answer: Contest Sacred Sites; letting them hold sites for free is roughly a loss.

spikes.label: Elephants and an early keep
spikes.detail: House of Learning with 10 or more scholars pre-placed on relics, then elephants with archers and an early keep.
spikes.answer: Elephants are slow. Janissaries, crossbows and spears counter them.

scout: Mosque in their base from the start
Scholars moving to Sacred Sites around 6:30

pairings.why: The Feudal army, with spears against better cavalry like Sipahi.
The Castle army, with some crossbows and men-at-arms; knights raid.

winConditions.detail: Gold from Sacred Sites, worth about 375 a minute with all three.
Elephant and archer push in Castle.

howToBeat: Play Feudal and contest every Sacred Site.
Mongols tower-rush the gold to stop scholars, and use Keshik against Ghazi.
